deduplication_deviation: 1000 raw source rows produced 999 unique records; all 999 must be evaluated
threshold_rationale: paper 1B OSNIP Table 3: ROUGE-L 0.157 vs clean 0.178 = 88.2% retention; BERTScore 0.840 vs 0.854 = 98.4% RP. A 0.95 ROUGE-L gate would fail the paper's own 1B result; 0.85 is the absolute floor and BERTScore remains the headline retention.
limitations: ROUGE-L uses the existing whitespace-tokenized local implementation; not claimed identical to paper scorer.
Scorer local manifest and every model/tokenizer SHA-256 must be verified at execution; mirror equivalence to a particular Hugging Face revision remains unproven.
One greedy generation per prompt; formal multi-seed report compares independent training seeds.
